decisions.question: Is the paper visibly stuffed inside the cup, rather than merely nearby or resting on its rim?
decisions.criteria: Compare SOURCE with EDITED. Pass only if EDITED shows the paper inside the cup and visibly inserted or compressed into it; fail if it remains outside, merely touches or rests on the rim, or is inside without visible evidence of being stuffed. Unknown if the paper or cup cannot be observed well enough to judge.
